lead_raw_text:
The structure of K4Mn2Bi2O12 (reduced formula K2MnBiO6) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 20 atoms per unit cell across four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies octahedral coordination for Bi, Mn, and K centers, each surrounded by six O neighbors, with K–O distances of 3.0482 Å and Bi–O and Mn–O distances of 2.1491 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites, and validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner-sharing between BiO6 and MnO6 octahedra and edge-sharing between BiO6 and KO6 octahedra.
